# CONSTRUCTED INPUT, NOT A CAPTURE. No EC was read to make this file; every
# byte below was written by hand. See README.md.
# Shape: `ecrw.py dump 0x0F00 0x0060` as §3's step 0 takes it for the fan-table
# range, the same page as the `...-moved-fan-` pair above. This pair's after
# dump differs at the three mailbox bytes and at nothing else, which is the
# false-positive shape: a host poke with no table write behind it, where §4.2
# must read `unchanged across the block` and only the trigger group moves.
# Every value here is invented; not a prediction that a table stays put.
0f00: 2a 2e 32 36 3a 3e 42 46 4a 4e 52 56 5a 5e 62 66
0f10: 00 24 28 2c 30 34 38 3c 40 44 48 4c ff ff ff ff
0f20: 00 30 30 40 4c 58 64 70 7c 88 94 a0 ac b8 c4 d0
0f30: 24 24 26 28 2a 2c 2e 30 32 34 36 38 ff ff ff ff
0f40: 00 26 26 2c 32 38 3e 44 4a 50 5c 62 68 6e 74 7a
0f50: 00 30 30 40 4c 58 64 70 7c 88 94 a0 ac b8 c4 d0
